body:
Just to explain why i have made this change:
 
I have installed svgo with this command `npm install -g svgo` to stop using `svgcleaner` which always make the static checks fails after cleaning any icon. Then I have created a task that cleans all svg icons in `editor/icons` and `scene/theme/icons` using the config that Godot already have and once i run the task it floods my terminal with `removeScriptElement is deprecated use removeScripts instead`. Also svgo have changed the default `removeViewBox` and `removeTitle` to false so the same config may show different results and make the static checks fails even if we ignore the deprecation warning.

```
svgo --quiet --config $GODOT_SOURCE/misc/utility/svgo.config.mjs $GODOT_SOURCE/editor/icons/*.svg $GODOT_SOURCE/scene/theme/icons/*.svg
```
